pattern.description: The timeline body scrolls up a few pixels under the fixed header and quarter row; both idea cards move together and the card's hover icon drops as the pointer leaves it.
pattern.why_premium: Weak: a small incidental scroll in the screen recording rather than an authored move. It only nudges the content and does not change what the viewer is reading.

build_hint.gsap: gsap.to('.timeline-body', {y:'-=4', duration:0.17, ease:'power2.out'}) inside an overflow:hidden container; tl.set('.card-expand-icon', {autoAlpha:0}) at the start.
build_hint.remotion: translateY = interpolate(frame, [start, start+5], [0, -4], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad), extrapolateRight:'clamp'}) on the timeline body inside a clipped container; no spring.

notes: Very small vertical shift (about 4 px; camera verdict none, pan_y -0.0037), so it is treated as an in-panel scroll, not a camera move. It could also be a re-render jitter after the e075 drag. The union box b01 and the band box b03 cover the same moving cards and are not listed separately.
